title: Existing Prototype Baseline and Vertical-Slice Gap Audit
objectives: Inventory current systems and map them to the canonical architecture.
Define and, where read-only inspection permits, capture the current performance baseline.
Identify the smallest gap between the prototype and the first playable mission.
Produce staged implementation tasks without changing code.
hard_locks: No engine migration proposal without measured evidence.
validation: Every task references a canonical document.
No frozen file is scheduled for unrelated modification.
